IMPORTANT SCOPE BOUNDARY: this Act establishes the Animal Sentience Committee for POLICY-SCRUTINY purposes only (covers vertebrates plus cephalopod molluscs and decapod crustaceans, s.5). It does NOT amend or extend AWA 2006's criminal-offence scope - cephalopods/decapods are NOT thereby brought within the criminal cruelty offences. No provisions rows are created under this instrument in v1 because it creates no offence or penalty of its own; see UK-ENG-AWA2006-P1 notes for the same boundary stated from the criminal-law side.

Full amendment history includes 16 dates (2000-2023); the 2023-07-27 entry is purely a ministry-name update (行政院農業委員會->農業部), not substantive - official English translation reflects the 2021-05-19 text, which remains substantively current. Related statute 野生動物保育法 (Wildlife Conservation Act) covers naturally-occurring wild species, distinct from APA's human-reared scope. A widely-circulated 2025-10-15 'amendment' claim (same fine figures, same legislator, same 'first in Asia' framing as the real 2017 event) is a MISDATED ECHO of 2017, not a real event - law.moj.gov.tw's amendment history confirms no amendment occurred in 2024 or 2025. A genuine draft amendment (owner-abandonment penalties, shelter/adoption changes, breeding-permit/sterilization rules, source-traceability, expanded inspector authority) was approved by the Executive Yuan 2026-01-08, pending Legislative Yuan review - NOT yet enacted.

title_official: 動物の愛護及び管理に関する法律
title_en: Act on Welfare and Management of Animals
notes: Act No.105 of 1973, originally titled 動物の保護及び管理に関する法律, renamed in the 1999 amendment. Official English translation's own version banner states 'Last Version: Act No.68 of 2005' - reflects pre-2012/pre-2019 law, do NOT cite it for current penalties. e-Gov's Japanese-language primary text (laws.e-gov.go.jp) is JS-rendered and could not be fetched as machine-readable text this round - article numbers are corroborated via the NPA's own statistical report and env.go.jp's revision pages instead.

Cruelty offence sits in the PRIMARY Act (Part IV, ss.41-48), not subsidiary legislation - no 'Animals and Birds (Cruelty to Animals) Rules' exists (a commonly assumed but incorrect instrument name, checked against the full subsidiary-legislation list). Wildlife offences sit in a SEPARATE statute (Wildlife Act 1965, formerly Wild Animals and Birds Act, renamed by the 2020 Amendment Act).

Duty-of-care + unnecessary-suffering dual structure mirrors England & Wales (AWA 2006). Also covers: ban on animals as prizes, raised minimum purchase age, and abandonment (explicitly RE-AFFIRMED as its own offence, unlike England where abandonment is only implicitly treated as a form of unnecessary suffering).

title_en: Council Directive 98/58/EC concerning the protection of animals kept for farming purposes
notes: Excludes wild animals, competition/show/cultural-event animals, experimental/lab animals, and ANY INVERTEBRATE from its farmed-animal welfare regime. Imposes a RESULT obligation on member states (ensure keepers avoid unnecessary pain/suffering/injury), leaving offence definitions/tiers/penalties to national transposition - no EU-level penalty exists. No provisions rows created under this instrument - present as a framework/harmonization layer only.

title_official: EU Animal Welfare Package - Regulation on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
title_en: EU dogs and cats welfare and traceability Regulation
notes: Proposed 2023-12-07 by the Commission following a Fitness Check of existing EU animal-welfare law. STATUS AS OF SEPT 2026 GENUINELY UNCERTAIN: conflicting adoption dates across two official-source fetches - European Parliament Legislative Train page states Parliament adopted 2026-04-28/Council approved 2026-05-22; European Commission food-safety page instead states 'formally adopted and signed... in June 2026.' Both agree final/near-final adoption has been reached, awaiting Official Journal publication - DO NOT treat either specific date as authoritative without checking the EUR-Lex procedure file directly. Substantive provisions confirmed: EU-wide minimum standards for breeding establishments/pet shops/shelters; mandatory traceability/ID with a public verification website; minimum weaning age 8 weeks for puppies/kittens absent veterinary justification. A parallel Animal Transport Regulation revision remains under negotiation with no adoption date; broader on-farm welfare revisions appear deferred beyond 2027. No provisions rows created (not yet in force).

Predecessor law Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren (1992) appears still PARTIALLY in the index (likely residual provisions pending full phase-out) - which parts remain is unconfirmed. A consolidated version effective 2025-01-01 exists but its specific amending act/content was NOT identified this round - open gap.

title_official: Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines (AAWS&G)
title_en: Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines
notes: NON-BINDING at the federal level - 'designed to be implemented in state and territory legislation,' developed by the multi-jurisdictional Animal Welfare Task Group, only legally binding once a state/territory enacts them. No provisions rows created under this instrument since it creates no enforceable federal offence. Australia has NO single federal animal-cruelty statute; welfare is constitutionally a state/territory responsibility. The Australian Animal Welfare Strategy (a 2000s national coordination framework) has effectively wound down - advisory committee disbanded, national funding withdrawn. The Export Control Act 2020 (Cth) premise (federal live-export legal basis) could NOT be verified this round - background knowledge only, not confirmed against a primary source.
